parameters.query:
select * from pricing_rules
where service_type ilike '{{ $('Insert Lead').item.json.service_type }}'
and region_code = '{{ $('Insert Lead').item.json.extracted_data.state }}'
and is_active = true
and effective_from <= now()
and (effective_to is null or effective_to > now())
order by effective_from desc
limit 1;

value.event_payload: ={{ JSON.stringify({ price: $('Lookup Pricing Rule').item.json.base_price, service_type: $('Parse Extracted Data').item.json.extracted.service_type }) }}

parameters.query:
select * from leads
where email = '{{ $json.body.payload.email }}'
order by created_at desc
limit 1;

parameters.query:
select *, round(extract(epoch from (now() - created_at))/60, 1) as minutes_open
from exception_queue
where status = 'open' and created_at < now() - interval '1 minute'
order by created_at asc;
